market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL hit settle >= $120 by end of June requires +17.7% from current $101.94 with closing-settle requirement (not intraday). Even at the April Iran-driven peak WTI did not settle that high. Possible only with significant supply shock; over ~2 months timeframe somewhat plausible but not base case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Probability of fresh major Iran/Hormuz disruption causing settle close above $120.
